notes: NOTE for 4.1.5 users: the in-app download can stick at 0% on 4.1.5 — if it does, tap Cancel and install the APK file sent in chat, it updates the same app. WHAT'S NEW IN 4.1.7: (1) VIDEO FIXED — videos now play through a direct stream (adaptive 360p video + audio played in sync); the old code only accepted formats YouTube no longer serves, so every video fell back to a heavy player that never loaded. If a video still fails, the app now says WHY. (2) UPDATE AUTO-INSTALLS — the install screen opens by itself the moment the download finishes, on the same screen; if the app is in the background, a notification offers the install instead. New versions also arrive as a tray notification. (3) LYRICS FULL-SCREEN — tap Lyrics in the player and lyrics open full-screen with the current line highlighted and auto-scrolling as the song plays. (4) PERMISSIONS — Location, Files & Media, Contacts and Notifications are each asked with a clear reason when needed (Settings → Permissions); Location shows your city on Home. (5) BACKGROUND PLAYBACK SURVIVES SWIPE-AWAY — remove the app from recents and the song keeps playing until you stop it; the floating Island stays too, with the song's photo, EQ and play/pause. (6) NEW GLASS LOGO everywhere + premium glass player + animated update banner. SONGS LIKE THE WEB — full songs resolve the way the web app does: YouTube audio raced in parallel with JioSaavn; Saavn timeout 90s so it finishes even at 1 KB/s. If no full song is found the player now SAYS WHY instead of silent Preview Only.
